description: The plot illustrates the relationship between layer number and the mean absolute value of the hidden state. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 25, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled “Abs Mean” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 4, with tick labels at intervals of 1. A dashed blue line, labeled “hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71”, begins at approximately 0.1 at layer 0, increases to a maximum of approximately 1.6 at layer 12, then declines to approximately 0.8 at layer 18, and rises sharply to approximately 4.1 at layer 25. A dotted orange line, labeled “hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05”, remains relatively constant at approximately 0.02 from layer 0 to layer 25. A solid green line, labeled “hidden state”, is a horizontal line at approximately 0.01 across the entire range of layer values from 0 to 25.
